frame: datum frame of intake/alignment.json: z=0 flange top face (material below), origin = midpoint of cup A/B axes, +X from cup A axis to cup B axis; theta CCW about +Z from +X. Lists: cups [A (-X), B (+X)], ears [neg (-X), pos (+X)].

cup_pitch.estimator: distance between cup A and cup B axis centres (wall-face IRLS, z 1.2-3.6, 3 stations each) = the clock feature_line; cups at x = -/+ pitch/2
cup_pitch.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

flange_half_width.estimator: half of (median y of the +y straight skirt side - median y of the -y side), sections z -0.5/-1.0/-1.5, |x|<15

flange_centre_y.estimator: mid of the two straight skirt sides (same sections); the flange sits 0.14 mm -y of the cup-axis line
flange_centre_y.note: kept, not snapped to 0: 3.5x the plane noise floor; the end arcs (cy -0.137/-0.122) agree

flange_end_arc_cx.estimator: IRLS circle (Cauchy 0.3) on skirt section points with |x|>22, |y|>5.8 per end; arc radius set = flange_half_width (tangent stadium)
flange_end_arc_cx.note: measured arc radii 14.679 / 14.642 vs half width 14.716 (0.04-0.07 apart)

end_face_x.estimator: median x of +-X-facing faces |y|<3.5, z -2.5..11 (ear tab outer face; the flange end flat is flush with it: m01 end_flat_x -34.164 / 34.303)

skirt_bottom_z.estimator: deepest scanned skirt z per 10-deg perimeter bin; the 6 deepest bins span -3.03..-3.17 (scan edge is ragged; the true edge is at or below the deepest reach)

flange_top_z.estimator: primary datum plane; median z of up-facing faces |z|<0.3

wall_t.estimator: not scanned (underside and interiors); typical moulded wall; owner chose a hollow shell (DECISIONS.md 2026-09-28)
wall_t.evidence: DECISIONS.md OTHER interior design intent; intake/coverage.json
wall_t.note: applies to flange plate, skirt, cup, shoulder and boss walls

cup_lower_r0.estimator: lower outer wall r at z=0 from a line fit to 0.25-mm z-bin medians of meridian r, z 0.9..6.6, sectors >30 deg from +-X
cup_lower_r0.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

cup_lower_draft_deg.estimator: atan(-slope) of the same binned-median line

cup_upper_r0.estimator: upper outer wall line r(z) intercept at z=0 (binned medians z 7.8..10.7)

cup_upper_draft_deg.estimator: atan(-slope) of the upper-wall binned-median line

cup_step_z_lo.estimator: last 0.05-mm bin whose median r is within 0.04 of the lower-wall line

cup_step_z_hi.estimator: first bin above step_z_lo whose median r is within 0.04 of the upper-wall line; step modelled as a cone between the two knees

cup_top_z_r9.estimator: top annulus cone: line fit z(r) to 0.2-mm r-bin medians, r 8.4..10.1 (rms of medians 0.009 / 0.016), evaluated at r = 9
cup_top_z_r9.note: it1 attempt 2: replaces the flat cup_top_z (median 12.338 / 12.259, m03) after the builder self-check showed a ring on the flat top

cup_top_slope_deg.estimator: atan(-dz/dr) of the same line (top falls outward)

cup_top_round_r.estimator: Kasa circle on meridian points of the top outer corner (rms 0.107 / 0.168)

shoulder_angle_deg.estimator: line fit z(r) on meridian points r 4.4..7.4 (conical shoulder), angle from horizontal

shoulder_z_at_r5.estimator: the same line evaluated at r = 5

barb_shank_r.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify
barb_shank_r.note: A and B differ by 0.13 (> noise); kept per barb, not averaged

shank_fillet_r.estimator: Kasa circle on meridian points r 2.6..3.9, z 14.6..16.4 (shoulder-to-shank round; rms 0.22)

barb_flare_z0.estimator: z where the flare line r(z) (fit z 23.0..24.2) meets the shank radius

barb_lip_r.estimator: median of the 50 largest meridian r in z 23.6..25.0
barb_lip_r.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

barb_top_z.estimator: median z of meridian points r 1.9..2.8, z > 28

barb_tip_r.estimator: taper line r(z) (fit z 25.0..27.9, rms 0.068/0.123) evaluated at barb_top_z; profile runs lip -> tip straight
barb_tip_r.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

barb_bore_r.estimator: Kasa circle on the open-boundary loop at the barb B tip (73 verts, z 27.7..28.6, rms 0.21); barb A loop not closed -> same value used
barb_bore_r.note: bore depth beyond ~0.9 mm is not scanned: assumed through into the cup cavity

boss_r0.estimator: line fit r(z) on meridian points z 1..10.5 about x=0 (rms 0.10)

boss_top_z_r4.estimator: boss top cone: line fit z(r) to 0.2-mm r-bin medians r 2.6..5.2 (rms 0.014), at r = 4
boss_top_z_r4.note: it1 attempt 2: replaces the flat boss_top_z (median 12.354, m03)

boss_top_round_r.estimator: Kasa circle on the top outer corner (rms 0.17)

boss_hole_r.estimator: Kasa circle on the open-boundary loop in the boss top (82 verts, z 11.0..11.8)
boss_hole_r.note: hole assumed through into the boss cavity

web_half_width.estimator: median |y| of the +-y-facing web side faces (4 webs x 2 sides), z 1..12
web_half_width.scatter_note: four identical 1.9-mm moulded ribs by intent; side-face medians scatter 0.135 on a rough, partly occluded face; residual <= 0.07 per side

web_top_z.estimator: median z of up-facing faces on the web tops |y|<0.8
web_top_z.scatter_note: one rib height by intent (cup tops 12.26-12.34, boss 12.35); residual <= 0.09

tab_inner_x.estimator: mean of the medians of the cup-facing tab faces either side of the web (x 31.8..33.2)

tab_half_width_z0.estimator: line fit of the tab half-width (median side-face y, 4 z bands) vs z, value at z=0

tab_side_draft_deg.estimator: atan(-slope) of that line (each side tapers inward going up)

lug_top_z.estimator: median z of up-facing lug faces x 34.5..41.5, |y|<3.5 (also the tab top)

lug_bottom_z.estimator: p1 z of the lug side faces (x 35..41): the lowest the scan saw the side walls; the underside itself is not scanned
lug_bottom_z.note: a bound, not a seen face: the underside may sit lower only if the side walls were occluded below 12.2

lug_half_width.estimator: half of the gap between median +-y lug side faces, x 34.5..38.5

lug_end_x.estimator: p99 of |x| of lug-end faces |y|<2 (end arc apex); end = semicircle of radius lug_half_width

lug_hole_cx.estimator: IRLS circle on hole-wall section points z 13.6/13.9/14.2/14.5
lug_hole_cx.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

lug_hole_r.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading on this feature -> re-run measure/rebuild/verify

simplifications.name: cup wall ripple
simplifications.deviation_cost: raw-point rms about the line 0.08-0.17 mm (m03 lower/upper wall rms) vs 0.02-0.04 mm for the bin medians

simplifications.name: barb shank
simplifications.deviation_cost: p10-p90 spread A 0.40 / B 0.36 mm (rough scan on a small radius)

simplifications.name: barb tip taper
simplifications.deviation_cost: fitted taper line rms 0.068 / 0.123 mm; lip edge sharp

simplifications.name: webs, tabs
simplifications.modelled_as: planar ribs of one width; tab as a trapezoid prism
simplifications.deviation_cost: web side scatter 0.135 (<= 0.07 per side); tab half-width line residual < 0.05

simplifications.name: cosmetic parting line on the cup shoulders along y=0
simplifications.deviation_cost: faint ridge, < 0.1 mm high (m05 shaded top view)

CHK-COUNT.note: no rotational patterns: 2 cups, 1 boss, 4 webs, 2 ears counted directly in sections and the top view (m05_heightmap.png)

CHK-ACHIEVABLE.note: no caliper readings (scan-only run): nothing to check

CHK-CLUSTER.note: top-view height map and meridian profiles show no unexplained material; above the cups only the barbs (coverage radial bands); faint y=0 ridge on the shoulders = parting line (cosmetic, declared); junk facets at the tab/lug junction x~+-33 z 12.5-14.5 are scan artefacts (many small loops, no flat top)

CHK-FRAME.note: no angles carried over from intake; all positions re-measured on intake/aligned_work.stl in the frozen datum frame

open_questions: Interior (underside, cup/boss cavities, bore depth) is assumed: wall 1.2 mm, hollow shell (owner decision).
Lug underside not scanned: lug_bottom_z is the lowest visible side-wall point.
